title: SPEAR: Structure Property Explainability with Attention Regularization
abstract: arXiv:2608.13826v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine learning is increasingly used to learn structure property relationships from spectroscopic and diffraction data, yet its adoption in materials discovery is often limited by poor interpretability of model predictions. Although attention mechanisms are frequently treated as inherently explainable, unregularized attention can yield unstable, fragmented, or intensity driven attribution patterns that obscure the physical origin of these relationships. Here we introduce SPEAR (Structure Property Explainability with Attention Regularization), a framework that constrains attention distributions during training to improve their stability, selectivity, and physical interpretability. translated_title: SPEAR：基于注意力正则化的结构-性能可解释性方法
translated_abstract: 机器学习越来越多地被用于从光谱和衍射数据中学习结构-性能关系，然而其在材料发现中的应用常常受到模型预测可解释性差的限制。尽管注意力机制常被视为天然可解释的，但未正则化的注意力可能产生不稳定、碎片化或强度驱动的归因模式，从而模糊了这些关系的物理起源。在此，我们引入了SPEAR（基于注意力正则化的结构-性能可解释性方法），这是一个在训练过程中约束注意力分布以提高其稳定性、选择性和物理可解释性的框架。SPEAR通过可学习的温度参数增强基于注意力的回归，以控制注意力集中度，并加入平滑性惩罚以强制相邻光谱位置间的连贯性，将注意力视为可学习的解释对象而非简单工具。
tldr: 本文提出SPEAR框架，通过可学习温度和平滑性惩罚正则化注意力分布，显著提升光谱数据分析中模型预测的稳定性和物理可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SPEAR, a framework that regularizes attention distributions via learnable temperature and smoothness penalties, enhancing stability and physical interpretability of model predictions in spectroscopic data analysis.
